results.content: # U.S. Open preview 2026: 30 tennis champions, contenders and rising stars to watch in New York. The U.S. Open 2026 starts Sunday at the Billie Jean King National Tennis Center, and on the hard courts of New York City, fans should expect surprises of all kinds. In the men’s draw, Carlos Alcaraz is trying to defend his title as he returns from an injury to his right wrist that kept him off the court for four months. His nearest rival, world No. 1 Jannik Sinner, is out with a right knee injury, and the likes of French Open champion Alexander Zverev, 24-time Grand Slam champion Novak Djokovic and a clutch of top American talent will be looking to take advantage.
